label: PLANET IGS-5225-8P2S2X (hardware version 4)
description: PLANET IGS-5225-8P2S2X industrial Layer 3 managed PoE switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T 802.3af/at PoE+ RJ45 (36 W a port), 2x 100/1000/2500BASE-X SFP (ports 9-10), 2x 10GBASE-SR/LR SFP+ (ports 11-12, backward compatible with 1G/2.5G SFP), 240 W PoE budget on dual 48-54 V DC input, 66 Gbps non-blocking fabric, 49.107 Mpps, IP30 DIN-rail case, -40 to 75 C.

poe.note: 240 W maximum on dual power input, per the hardware version 4 datasheet. 802.3at/end-span PSE, ports 1-8 only: 15.4 W a port at 802.3af, 36 W a port at 802.3at (51-54 V DC). The sheet rates the whole box at 267 W fully loaded with PoE, which is the 240 W budget plus about 27 W of system load, so the budget rather than 8 x 36 W is the ceiling. PoE extend mode reaches 200 m at reduced pair count.

fabric.note: 66 Gbps non-blocking and 49.107 Mpps at 64 bytes, 32K MAC table, 16 Mbit shared buffer, 10 KB jumbo frames. 8x 1G duplex + 2x 2.5G duplex + 2x 10G duplex = 66 Gbps, so the stated fabric is arithmetic rather than marketing.

notes: Datasheet C-IGS-5225-8P2S2Xv4_L.pdf, hardware version 4; the product page's download table lists firmware 4.2412b251016 (2025-10-17) for that hardware. RJ45-to-RS232 console at 115200 8-N-1, 86 x 107.3 x 152 mm, 1353 g, dual 48-54 V DC (>51 V DC recommended for PoE+), 11.52 W idle / 267 W fully loaded, IP30 aluminium case, 6 kV DC Ethernet ESD. Layer 3: IPv4/IPv6 hardware static routing plus RIP, OSPFv2 and OSPFv3, 128 static routes, 128 VLAN interfaces. Modbus TCP and IEEE 1588v2 transparent clock. The 240 W budget is stated as 'depending on power input', so it assumes both feeds connected; a single feed carries what it can.
